request.promptText: Animate this Korean classroom teacher shot as a quiet thinking pause. Keep the exact same teacher identity as the reference image: white-blue gradient hair, purple eyes, Korean traditional gat, black hanbok, black gloves. The teacher stays on the right side of the frame in front of the green chalkboard, holding a gentle waiting pose with a hopeful smile, as if giving the learner time to think. Use very subtle motion: breathing, small head movement, tiny hand relaxation, mild camera drift. Keep the chalkboard blank and clean. No readable text, no alarm text, no subtitles, no watermarks, no yellow tone change.
